about: BLD 897, BLD 899: the paintings behind the 3D figure. Lookup: art id, workouts[id], a painting named by the workout id, categories[category], fallback[kind], default; then a painting's stage (another painting id) when its own scene has no room for a person (cards keep their own painting). Per painting: src (under base), floor (0 to 1 down) where the feet stand, scale (a 1.73 m person's height at that floor line, as a share of the painting's height), focal [x, y] (x kept under the figure), light [x right, y up], tone (0 to 1) toward Grounded's sepia, mat (true when the figure uses the painting's own mat), mode ('study': a soft backdrop with a plain floor band, for a painting with no room), open [x0, y0, x1, y1] (the open, dry, level floor), avoid [[x0, y0, x1, y1], ...] (objects, furniture, and water the body must keep clear of when they stand in front of it), room (the fit grade). See ART.md.
